home.title: Welcome to Vicarage Living
home.subtitle: We are a Danish family living in Sweden — making a home in an old vicarage, learning Swedish traditions, and embracing everyday life.

about.title: About Us
about.description: We are a family of four with two dogs who have chosen to take a different path in life. From Birkerød in Denmark, we moved to Vireda in Småland—a decision that grew out of the COVID-19 pandemic and gave us the courage to pause and reflect on what we truly wanted from everyday life. We have moved into the old vicarage in Vireda, a house full of history, soul, and space for both dreams and reality. Here, surrounded by forest, silence, and nature, we share life, daily routines, and everything that comes with it: renovations, everyday tasks, traditions, and a slower life with more presence.
